WITH account_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    account_id,
    AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE -amount END) as avg_signed_amount,
    COUNT(*) as num_transactions
  FROM trans
  GROUP BY account_id
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(num_transactions) as avg_trans_per_account
  FROM account_stats
)
SELECT 
  a.account_id,
  a.avg_signed_amount,
  a.num_transactions,
  a.num_transactions / o.avg_trans_per_account as ratio
FROM account_stats a
CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The undocumented transaction type 'VYBER' is treated as a withdrawal (negative) per the request's explicit instruction to treat 'VYDAJ' and 'VYBER' as withdrawals, despite the verified data noting VYBER's direction is not stated.
